title: Plastic Packaging Tax — mechanically recycled plastic packaging - GOV.UK

triage.reason: GOV.UK published the government response to the May 2026 consultation on recycled content certification, announcing that mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging under the Plastic Packaging Tax will be introduced from 1 April 2030, with details to be developed with industry.

draft.summary: The government published its response to the consultation 'Plastic Packaging Tax: potential certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging', which ran from 18 May 2026 to 10 August 2026 and received 116 responses. Having considered the responses, the government intends to introduce mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging from 1 April 2030.
draft.source_quote: The consultation received 116 responses from businesses, trade bodies and other stakeholders. A full summary of responses and the government response is available here. Having considered the consultation responses, the government intends to introduce mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging from 1 April 2030.

key_dates.text: Government intends to introduce mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging from 1 April 2030.

draft.interpretation: Businesses claiming recycled content in mechanically recycled packaging will need to evidence it through a certification scheme from 2030, so recyclers and converters may wish to track how the detailed requirements and market-readiness review develop.
